runtime.policy: Use this target runtime and its installed tooling; do not substitute the SOL07 runtime or install packages automatically.

rules.description: All users, dictionary choices, notices, time and failure switches below are synthetic. Transport uses a local mock only, never the production API. Every request is handled or refused locally; unknown paths never fall through to a real HTTP client.

List query uses noticeTitle, noticeType, pubTimeStart, pubTimeEnd, noticeStatus; pager uses current/size. Dates sent as YYYYMMDD. Mock title matching is substring, other populated filters are exact and date bounds are inclusive. Ignore additional table UI pager/sorter keys; records follow mockNotices and each row includes noticeId/passKey/noticeStatus.
rules.responseEvidence: fb-ui 1.1.840 FbSimpleTable.vue:362-377 default dataParse, not an executed backend response

rules.description: View requests noticeId/passKey and returns one notice object under data when code=1. A missing or failing view does not unlock saving an incomplete record.

Add/update are JSON POST. This pilot explicitly sends noticeTitle, noticeType, pubTime, pubDeptId, pubDeptName, noticeRange, noticeStatus, noticeContent and file; update also sends noticeId/passKey from the mock detail or retained row identity. This is a bounded mock payload, not certification of all backend-required fields. Old code replaces formData with the view response, so its update passKey depends on that response containing it. Create a separate payload; file is {referType:'SYS1047',fileList:[{attachId}]}, not rich display records. Mock success returns data.noticeId and the saved state.

Single deletion uses the observed GET interface, noticeIds contains one ID and passKey is supplied. This reproduces the consumer contract in a mock, not a recommendation to design new deletion APIs with GET.
Dictionary families observed: X54 type, X55 range, X56 status. X5601/X5602 are the two statuses consumed by the page. Choice labels below are synthetic, not copied from real dictionary data.

Observed action codes: create OP_MANAGE_SMSNOTICE_ADD, edit OP_MANAGE_SMSNOTICE_UPDATE, view OP_MANAGE_SMSNOTICE_VIEW, delete OP_MANAGE_SMSNOTICE_DELETE. Mock can supply an empty set or individual permissions. Frontend tests do not prove server authorization.

UI noticeRange is always an array; request payload is an English-comma string. View response null, empty string or missing range normalizes to []. Repeated failure/success attempts retain UI selection. Proposed business rules D02/D03/D05/D07 remain pending.
Mock clock is 2026-11-21T09:00:00+08:00, used only for business date defaults; audit times are collected from the real clock. Mock user unit is UNIT-MOCK / 演练发布单位, never a real identity.

Observe list/view/add/update/delete/fileByReferId counters via mock transport. Controls support success, business failure {code:-1,message:'演练请求失败'} and rejected request Error('演练网络异常'). Failed saves do not mutate notices. Delayed responses allow double-click testing. A separate stale-row control returns published X5602 detail for a draft X5601 list row; this lets the public read-only transition requirement be tested. List failures display an error and retain previous data, or an empty list when no data was loaded. Counters and switches are test observations, not business APIs.

TP upload loads existing files by referId, separate from notice view. Mock GET /platform/file/refer-id receives referId/referType and returns {code:1,data:[{attachId,attachName,attachSize,mock:true}]}. Rich records use attachName, not name. Save uses {referType:'SYS1047',fileList:[{attachId}]}; the mock file registry resolves names again after saving/reopening. Allow doc/docx/xls/xlsx/pdf synthetic records to be selected/removed through a local-only control in edit mode; existing rows are read-only in both view modes. Do not invoke native real-file picking, upload, download or preview. If TP native callbacks would call a file service, intercept them in the mock harness; any unrecognized file URL is refused locally.

Read detail: title, unit, publication date, file records from the separate mock refer-id query, filtered body, Close. Published row view: form fields read-only with no save controls and the same separate file query. Layout uses the target standard list convention; do not equate code similarity with quality.

decisions.proposal: 查询回第一页；重置清空全部条件并回第一页查询一次
新增日期默认今天，编辑保留原值，日期只读
草稿只要求标题；发布要求标题、类型、单位、范围
保存或删除成功只刷新一次，保留筛选并回第一页；取消、只读关闭不刷新
保留两个只读入口差异；详情已发布时保守转只读；缺相应权限时直接调用页面写处理函数也不发写请求（仅前端防误操作）
有权限时两种状态均可单条删除；不扩撤回或批量
防重复、保存失败保留并可重试、发布失败不提前改状态；详情失败不允许保存，列表失败提示并保留旧数据或空列表

unknowns: Production backend validation, actual dictionary labels, passKey security, server-side status transitions and idempotency are not verified.
The list response example follows the installed table default; it is not an executed backend sample.
Real file lifecycle and rich-editor complex interactions are outside this first round.
